I am an old woman, and this small wheat plot near the house feeds my family. I will buy a little DAP and urea from the cooperative like my neighbors do, because wheat does not grow well here without it, but fertilizer is expensive so I cannot use as much as the extension people say. I will put the manure from my cattle on this plot since it is close to the house, and I will try to get improved seed from the cooperative because the yield is better. My sons and I will do most of the work by hand, and at harvest time I will call a few people to help because I am getting old and cannot cut all the wheat alone.
